notes.title: Early Access Update 0.4: Manual Battles Part 0
notes.content:
-Added initial access to manual battle features.
--A test scenario for manual battles can be accessed from the title screen.
--Currently, there is no proper UI for designating characters, spawning soldiers, etc.
--these functions are bound to keys instead.

---The following lords are available for playing and spawning:
----Karavi Champion (M/F)
----Vinsarr Knight (M/F)
----Karavi Archmaster (M/F)

---The following soldiers are available for spawning:
----Karavi Levy
----Nylleh Mage
----Vinsarr Bodyguard
----Karavi Patriot
----Karavi Bastion
----Karavi Lionsguard
----Karavi Wench
----Nylleh Shackled
----Karavi Heirsguard

-Main controls are as thus:
--Movement: WASD or Arrow keys
--Jump: Numpad 0
--Change Camera Mode: "C" Key
--Zoom/Pan Camera: "right Ctrl" Key
--Teleport to Location (DEBUG!): "P" Key
--Change Lord: Keys 1-6 (not numpad)
--Load Vinsarr Knight Data to Character (DEBUG!): "/" Key
--Spawn Lords: R, G, T, H, Y, J Keys
--Spawn Soldiers: E, F, K, L, Z, X, V, B, N, M, :, ", Ins, Home, PgUp, PgDn Keys
---(Might have missed a few, there. Have fun!)
--Primary Action: Left Click
--Secondary Action: Right Click
--Recenter Overhead Camera: Middle Click
--Toggle Automatic Allied Recuperation: - Key
--Down Self (DEBUG!) - I Key
--Recuperate Self (DEBUG!) - O Key

The AI may be a little buggy. I was testing a more advanced system before present circumstances hampered development time. I hope you enjoy, nevertheless, and I'll see you with the next update!

notes.title: Devlog 2: Champions and Crowdfunding
notes.content:
Hello Lords and Ladies!

It's been just under a month since Lords of the Darkreign released into Early Access, and it's time to check in with our progress! Since the last devlog, We've created most of the first Manual Battle location, implemented a Lord and player controller, and even managed to bring a bit of magic to the game. We've also begun setting up Crowdfunding to boost future development, which you will also (hopefully) enjoy. Let's get Started!

Tower Fields - Quick Battle Arena
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/7bb2969cca8f50f608693875c23e8d9f3e17492b.gif
Green boi Returneth!

Tower Fields is the name of our first Manual Battle location, where Quick Battles will be arranged. The arena features a large valley separating the two camps, and a tower in the center as a landmark to guide the battle. The area is designed to be characteristic of most of the Karavi lands, with a wide degree of foliage giving way to ruins and scorched battlefields.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/b2461ce2b2032a4801083ab99c12f0758eb2a3a9.gif
Yes, I am unnaturally excited that the trees move

The blocks on top of the tower are each exactly 1 Unity Unit cubed, which in-game is converted to a meter cubed. We are using this to scale each unit and item correctly, so that they adhere to the correct sizes given in the lore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/89a09deaac80aac01dfb91ccea74cb8421261ae0.gif
Our boi, being only 4 feet tall, has to have some hops to reach the third cube

Karavi Champion - The First Lord
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/472e31574ce1819fdd7220a3f725dfb7107e1810.gif
Never Mess with a short man, they may conquer the world

As you can see in the preview above, Lords can turn, attack, and move in any dimension in the world, and bring the camera with them. You can also zoom the camera in-and-out, and rotate it to focus on a different part of the battlefield. There will also be a third-person-shooter esque camera, but it didn't make it into this devlog.

Controls are simple: movement keys move your lord relevant to whichever rotation you have your camera set to, while your mouse decides what your lord is looking at, independent of movement. Attacks and other actions will be directed at the targeted location, decided by where your mouse first intersects an entity or object in the game world.

Perhaps another demonstration is in order?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/f0e9b3445bf4cf94441be5acc45232da7a3c6391.gif
Yes, this means you can attack above and below you, even with the "2d" camera

As you've no doubt noticed by now, there is an odd tracer-like entity that appears before the Champion takes an action. These are Action Guides, and they are intended to help you understand the area your attacks/actions will effect, before going through with them. Holding down the relevant mouse button (M1 for primary action, M2 for secondary action) will display the relevant action guides every half-second. Action guides have identical characteristics to the "projectile" that their action uses, except any on-hit effects, like damage, or physical characteristics, like bouncing, are removed. Action Guides use a strict white-to-black gradient, to differentiate them from true attacks.

For example, the melee Action Guide displays the two maximum extents horizontally that the attack will hit, as well as the center-line of where you're aiming. When the mouse button is released, the gray melee hitbox is released, following the same rules as its respective action guides. Likewise, the Pyre-spear's action guide features a white-to-black trail that mimics its true projectile, and will follow the same path until collision. Since Lord actions will be balanced around cooldowns rather than resources, its important that the player can understand where their attack will be aimed before committing to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/6b12e5f62e8155c9b0bf77d4e4b22bdf509c02a1.gif
With Action Guides, you can take repeated, long-range shots with ease!

Hopefully, Action Guides will allow players to predict the results of their actions easily, whether in overhead or third person camera modes.

Crowdfunding - Bolstering the Treasury

As a small indie developer, I have to closely monitor my financials to make sure I can keep developing the game. While I am determined to continue work on Lords of the Darkreign, I may have to switch off full-time development by the end of the year to keep afloat. To perhaps prevent this, I have begun creating several crowdfunding campaigns, such as the following Kickstarter.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rev21/ciel-compendium-lords-of-the-darkreign-manual-battles

If you are interested, I would appreciate any support you could give, no matter how small. The game has struggled with visibility since launch, and even merely telling your friends would be a great boon to my ability to continue this work full-time. Thus, for those of you who wish to support me, whether through word of mouth or this crowdfunding, I thank you all in advance.



With that out of the way, I hope you've enjoyed this devlog, and are excited for the Manual Battle update. It will likely have to be released piecemeal, to keep the game fresh with consistent updates, but I hope you enjoy it all the same. Thank you again for your time, and we'll see you beneath the Darkreign Storm!

notes.title: Devlog 1: Racial Base Models
notes.content:
Hello Lords and Ladies!

It's been just over a week since Lords of the Darkreign released into Early Access, and we have already finished the racial base models necessary for the first large update to the game. These will be used as the starting point for each individual lord and soldier, with the specific units being differentiated by armor, adornments, or other visual indicators. The material-based approach we used when designing these models should also allow faction colors to be represented visibly be each individual unit, allowing you to pick out friends and foes on the battlefield.

For many of you, this will be your first time exploring the world of Ciel. Thus, in this Devlog, we will be showing off some animation for each race/sex base model, while explaining some of the lore behind each race of Ciel, including how they are involved in the Darkreign Wars.

Karavi

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/c5651ffde5de164b4aa4beb59fe81cbd17d4d13c.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/4288fd9dfb9c913d30bdf20d4fee8522c3c24968.gif

The reunification of the Karavi realm is the central struggle of the Darkreign Wars, and thus it is only natural that its people do much of the fighting. Split among several different factions and creeds, the Karavi as a whole are categorized by a cunningness and ambition rarely seen in the other races, and innovations as a society that see them consistently among the most powerful forces on the battlefield, despite being the smallest and physically weakest of the six races. Some Karavi believe they were ordained by The Creator to conquer Ciel and rule all of the other races, while others, especially in the face of the Darkreign storm, fear The Creator now sees them as a blight on Ciel.

Yittak

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/956b92213b851a2bf8ac1fa537155b887250593a.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/e1edd21912a6a18d755e7d6e89096da427c24a04.gif

Long allies of the Karavi against the Vinsarr, the Yittak's democratic form of government has fallen into chaos in the last few centuries, as a brutal civil war ravaged their lands. Only now beginning to recover, the Light-government of the Yittak has not yet chosen a side in the Darkreign wars, although it is no secret that many Yittak despise the Unified Kingdom of Kilzhanarr, seeing it as a puppet-government run by the Vinsarr. It is no surprise, then, that some Yittak who fled in the diaspora reneged on their democratic beliefs, believing a strong monarchy like that of the Heir-Kingdom of Fanar to be the only way to counter the might of the Vinsarr Crown.

Nylleh

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/50ae47f9a28cb42c99ceae08c6fbb4be367da035.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/15d734137c9068da0bbd7ee0092854d651f61f42.gif

Facing decline after the fall of Illiarh to Fanar's forces, the Nylleh are responsible for the blockade of Karavi ports, strangling any hopes of escape by sea from the Darkreign. They, along with the Hokere and Light-Vaynar crowns, formally act in a state of war against the Heir-Kingdom of Fanar, and are known to occasionally raze any port-villages of theirs that lack sufficient defenders. However, unlike most other races, the Nylleh maintain at least some diplomatic contact with even their hated enemies, as their larger endeavors in Brand-hunting require coordination with locals even within these hostile realms.

Vinsarr

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/9ae1f6a21e9590eaa7c22e8bef2365d7e089cc33.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/da07e7a8ed1a6173fded0f2325d5cc9c1149108b.gif

Now the strongest realm in all of Ciel, the Vinsarr have long warred with the Karavi, and their capture of much of the Karavi heartland in the Second Conquest War is often preached as divine favor among their pastors and chaplains. However, this golden age is far from uncontested, and fear of reprisal, such as the purges initiated by the Rekindled Kingdom of the Lion and the Heir-Kingdom of Fanar, have caused the Vinsarr crown to refrain from a re-invasion of their lands to stamp out this resistance. It is to be seen whether this restraint will last, though, for many Vinsarr believe they could lead a great empire of conquest, and finally crush their enemies once and for all.

Hokere

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/1ce34fe264430bc49c6f3548005e053afb8c6dd9.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/3eaad63a6314b448d7eb579bec9cdbfa16fc47ba.gif

Once crippled by the loss of their Light of Ciel, the transfer of the Karavi Light to the Hokere crown through the blood of Hinohl Sunwings has ushered in an era of hope and growth for the Hokere. Even mending ties with their former enemies, the Nylleh and Vaynar, the Hokere stand on the precipice of a golden age not unlike that which the Vinsarr are experiencing, with advances in metallurgy in particular greatly bolstering their military capabilities. Though preferring to stay neutral in the Karavi and Vaynar civil wars, they have become bitter enemies of the Heir-Kingdom of Fanar, and are thus indirectly responsible for the continued survival of the Independent City-States, which currently are centered in Girn's Stay, well within strike range of the Hokere crown.

Vaynar

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/fe4b4ed16b0c578a3b476cdd70135dd860306d3c.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816100/50e1d7805e57a72c813078b8f6bae1f15fc6b2f5.gif

Invaded by the Karavi in the Second Conquest War, it was once though that the Vaynar would focus on rebuilding their Kingdom, after the calamity of the war. However, their current Light-King, Kalo, sought a different path, driven by fearsome nightmares to purge his realm of any Karavi remaining in his territory. This soon created a schism in Vaynar society, as those who would not commit to this wrath were cast out alongside the fleeing Karavi, to form the Kingdom of Banished Clans. A brutal civil war has raged off and on through the intervening years, and it is no secret that the Rekindled Kingdom of the Lion, which seeks to right the wrongs of its predecessor, is seen by many Vaynar as a path of hope for their people.

We hope you enjoyed this Devlog. Tune in next time to [strike]read another book[/strike] see what we're up to! Thank you for your time, and we'll see you beneath the Darkreign Storm!
